Restore a Stelae snapshot

Usage: dolos bootstrap stelae [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --force
          Replace any data already in storage, and with it what an interrupted bootstrap left for
          `--continue`
      --source <SOURCE>
          Where to restore from, as a URL naming a network root: `file://DIR`, a directory holding
          `dolos/` and `blocks/`, each an OCI image layout, or `oci://HOST/PATH`, whose `PATH/dolos`
          and `PATH/blocks` repositories are read. Defaults to the configured network's official
          root, and is required for a custom network
      --point <POINT>
          which snapshot to restore: `latest`, or `epoch-N` for the snapshot cut at the boundary
          that opens epoch N. Registry sources only [default: latest]
      --skip-if-data
          Exit 0 without bootstrapping when storage already holds a node, as an interrupted replay
          that has committed leaves one for `--continue` to resume; data without one, as an
          interrupted Stelae snapshot restore or a bootstrap interrupted before it commits a cursor
          leaves, and a store this release refuses are errors instead
      --insecure
          talk to the repository over plaintext HTTP rather than HTTPS; for a registry on a loopback
          address or a mirror inside a cluster, and for nothing reachable from outside one
      --verbose
          Enable verbose logging output
      --scratch-dir <DIR>
          directory to stage pulled layers in; defaults to `<storage.path>/scratch`. registry
          sources only — a `file://` restore stages nothing
      --skip-space-check
          skip the restore disk-space preflight and continue even when the estimate of what the
          restore will occupy exceeds the available space
      --read-ahead <LAYERS>
          how many layers to read ahead of the one being written; a registry restore stages each in
          the scratch directory until its turn. 0 or 1 reads one layer at a time. Default 64,
          lowered to fit 4 GiB of staging but never below 8
      --continue
          Resume an interrupted restore from the layers it recorded, reading the snapshot it started
          from again; with nothing to resume, restore as without the flag into storage that holds no
          data
      --registry-user <USER>
          the user to read the registry as; defaults to the published read-only user when the
          repository is the configured network's official one. The password comes from
          DOLOS_STELAE_PASSWORD or --registry-credentials-file [env: DOLOS_STELAE_USER=]
      --registry-credentials-file <PATH>
          a TOML file naming the registry secret as `password` or `token`; it takes the place of
          DOLOS_STELAE_PASSWORD / DOLOS_STELAE_TOKEN
  -c, --config <CONFIG>
          
  -h, --help
          Print help
